entry.title: US, China officially extend trade war truce by 2 months
entry.summary: The two countries said that they would maintain tariff reductions and a pause on other trade actions until Jan. 10, 2027, cementing a pact first announced in September.

entry.title: How Chili’s supply chain improvements are helping menu consistency
entry.summary: CSCO James Butler has reordered Chili’s supply chain priorities to focus on the customer experience, resulting in sales growth for the restaurant chain and its suppliers.

entry.title: Zipline raises $1.5B, plans US drone manufacturing expansion
entry.summary: The startup is building out its drone delivery nationwide network and recently inked deals with Walmart and Uber to launch additional sites.

entry.title: Deere to end production at 2 Iowa plants to align with demand
entry.summary: The heavy equipment maker also plans to shift some production from factories in Illinois and Louisiana.

entry.title: Bed Bath & Beyond parent to close Maryland distribution center
entry.summary: Neighborhood Intelligence is aiming “to rip out big chunks of costs” by reworking its supply chain, CEO Marcus Lemonis said.

entry.title: Amazon, alternative carriers gained parcel volume in 2026’s first half
entry.summary: The e-commerce giant has continued to grab market share as it relies less on UPS for shipping and expands its delivery reach, per ShipMatrix.

entry.title: Apparel shipper expands US fulfillment operations to skirt de minimis’ end
entry.summary: Australia-based OTAA, which makes ties and cufflinks, is fulfilling U.S. orders from a facility in Longview, Texas, through a partnership with Cart.com.

entry.title: Canada Goose will revisit pricing to blunt tariffs next year, CFO says
entry.summary: The Toronto-based luxury apparel company worked hard to get its products into the U.S. before new import tariffs became effective in August.

entry.title: Asics boosts inventory management using warehouse drones
entry.summary: By using the technology, the footwear brand has improved misplaced inventory recovery while slashing manual labor hours and increasing counting frequency.

entry.title: CarParts.com revs up in-house last-mile delivery for cost, speed benefits
entry.summary: The cost savings opportunity will be “substantial” as the company aims to deliver 300,000 packages a year via its internal network, per CEO David Meniane.
